text: Election of the Chair of the Toronto and East York Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting January 1, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022. All Members, including the incumbent, are eligible for election with one exception: a community council chair cannot also serve as the Speaker of City Council.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Gord Perks as Chair of the Toronto and East York Community Council for the term of office starting January 1, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
